item.title: Iranian, Indian judicial officials discuss cooperation on BRICS summit sidelines
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian and Indian judicial officials have held discussions on expanding bilateral and multilateral legal cooperation on the sidelines of a BRICS meeting of chief justices and senior judicial officials in New Delhi, with stronger judicial ties, arbitration and mediation emerging as key areas of focus.

item.title: Iranian fishermen celebrate their bond with Persian Gulf at Nowruz-e Darya local ceremony
item.description: Bandar Abbas, IRNA — The village of Selkh on Iran’s Qeshm Island on Thursday hosted Nowruz-e Darya (Sea Nowruz) ceremony, an age-old tradition among the coastal communities of the Persian Gulf that marks the beginning of a new fishing season and celebrates the deep bond between local people and the sea.

item.title: Nuclear threat narrative has been proven false: Iran VP Aref
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iran’s Vice President Mohammad Reza Aref says that the world has realized that the alleged nuclear threat used against Iran was nothing but a false narrative, stressing that the Islamic Republic remains committed to using advanced technologies to serve national and regional needs.

item.title: Sirik wedding attack echoes tragedy of Minab schoolchildren: Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s administration spokesperson, Fatemeh Mohajerani, says the recent US attack on the Sirik district in southern Hormozgan Province cannot be viewed separately from the earlier killing of schoolchildren in Minab, stressing that the United States, as the aggressor and initiator of the military action, should be held accountable for the tragedies.

Tehran, IRNA — Iran’s administration spokesperson, Fatemeh Mohajerani, says the recent US attack on the Sirik district in southern Hormozgan Province cannot be viewed separately from the earlier killing of schoolchildren in Minab, stressing that the United States, as the aggressor and initiator of the military action, should be held accountable for the tragedies.

item.title: New US–E3 push for IAEA anti-Iran resolution a sign of failure of ‘snapback illusion’: Iran Vienna mission
item.description: London, IRNA — Iran’s permanent mission to the United Nations and other international organizations in Vienna says a new attempt by the US and the three European countries of Germany, Britain, and France to refer Iran’s nuclear issue to the UN Security Council clearly shows “the complete failure of the snapback illusion” they have already pursued.
